metadata.description: muningis' personal Claude Code skills & plugins marketplace

plugins.name: snare
plugins.description: Reproduction-driven red/green bugfix loop: reproduce a bug, trap it in a failing test, fix it, then re-run the exact same flow to prove it's gone.

plugins.name: sniff
plugins.description: Sniff out a real error from an app/service's logs, normalize it into a reproduction recipe, and hand it to snare. Source auto-detected per repo, confirmed once, then cached to .claude/sniff.json.

plugins.name: recap
plugins.description: Summarize what you worked on across Claude Code sessions since the last recap — a ready-to-paste standup of the tasks you actually drove, grouped by project.

plugins.name: trail
plugins.description: Decision archaeology: reconstruct WHY code is the way it is by following its trail through git history and past Claude Code sessions — the reasoning and rejected alternatives a commit message never captures.

plugins.name: rinse
plugins.description: Verification loop for finished work: run the repo's checks, fix what fails, then re-run the WHOLE set — a fix routinely breaks a sibling — and hand you the short list only a human can confirm. Check set cached to .claude/rinse.json.

plugins.name: baton
plugins.description: Hand a session off to the next one: write a handover — mission, observed git state, decisions and rejected alternatives, dead ends, next steps — for a single repo, a multi-repo workspace, or an exploration workspace, then resume from it in the fresh session.

plugins.name: scruff
plugins.description: Mentor mode: teach, don't type. Scruff briefs you on the structure and verified doc links to build it yourself, keeps its paws off your files, then grabs you by the scruff at review time and grills what you built — every criticism backed by proof, not vibes.

plugins.name: kit
plugins.description: Kit out a repo with code intelligence: detect the languages it uses, fetch the matching language servers, and enable the LSP plugins in that repo's own .claude/settings.json — scoped there, nothing global.
